newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia BTC shareholders approve capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia BTC shareholders approve capital rise.

text.p: Slovenian warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC said on Tuesday its shareholders had approved the company's plan to seek fresh capital in order to finance new investment.

"Shareholders today approved the management's plan to enlarge the company's capital by up to 2.4 billion tolars ($15.2 million) or 50 percent of the current capital over the next five years," Helena Petrin, BTC's general secretary, told Reuters.

She said the company had already held talks with foreign and domestic investors but had not yet determined any details of the capital increase. The company said an issue of global depository receipts (GDR) was among the options.

Over the coming years, BTC plans to modernise its facilities, build a new shopping centre in Ljubljana and invest in new parking areas around its shopping centers. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
